modifications.description: Qualify fixed native helpers and process replies; require listening, stopped/join proof and complete allocation cleanup; retain uncertain native resources.
Bound program-index traversal to the owned serialization buffer and reject repeated or invalid node addresses.
Stream the selected game as a read-only ZIP64 archive through a Mac loopback endpoint with bounded catalog metadata and file buffers.
Add a Download all ZIP link to the selected game WebDAV listing when a local archive endpoint is active.
Pass the Mac archive endpoint port to the native WebDAV listing without changing the fixed configuration size.
